title: Renew Your Focus on Worship
description:
It's a time for renewal, refocus, refresh. A time to remember what's important in life. And for any submissive, one of those things is worship. Worshipping your dominant in any way you can.

In this file, I simply want to remind you that you are focused on that. You will be gently hypnotized and given a little re-calibration to make sure you're not just worshipping your dominant for your own desires, but for positive reasons too.

You'll be told just how important it is you look after yourself, and how important it is to be kind, and grateful for what your dominant does for you.

This file is gender-neutral in all directions, so if your dominant is male, if you're female, it doesn't matter. You can listen to this if your dominant isn't me - this is broadly about how you treat that special person, regardless of who they are.
author: Mistress Calia
